speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng
text: asked the Minister for Manpower (a) how are our tripartite partners working with local universities to ensure graduates find relevant or full-time employment amidst a tightening labour market; and (b) how can the Ministry improve the job matching rate for graduates.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
text: AUs conduct regular reviews of course curricula, incorporating feedback from economic agencies and industry.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
text: AUs have also worked with employers to provide meaningful internships for students as important components for many of their courses.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
text: The AUs also provide career-related information to students and graduates through career talks, fairs and online resources.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
text: Students and graduates can consult career coaches for more personalised career and upgrading advice.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
text: In addition to the services provided by AUs, graduates can approach Workforce Singapore (WSG) and NTUC's e2i for career advisory and one-on-one coaching at their centres.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
text: Graduates can also access WSG's MyCareersFuture (MCF) portal to search and apply for jobs.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
text: They can make use of features such as CareersFinder on MCF to help them better plan for their careers.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
text: These support graduates to take charge of their career health by making more informed career decisions and longer-term plans.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
text: NTUC and SNEF's efforts complement what the Government is doing.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
text: NTUC also set up mentorSHIP to increase access to career mentoring for youths.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
text: These initiatives help youths gain more clarity about job fit, pick up relevant skills and find jobs that match their competencies and aspirations.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
text: Overall, a tight labour market should benefit graduates in their job search, meaning less difficulties in seeking out full-time employment with a good job fit.

speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
text: Is the Ministry considering exploring innovative partnerships with non-traditional stakeholders like tech companies or startup incubators to create new job opportunities for graduates?

speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
text: Second, how is the Ministry leveraging technology and data analytics to improve job matching for graduates and connect them with relevant opportunities across different sectors?

speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
text: To his first question about exploring innovative partnerships with tech companies and also startup incubators, the answer is yes.

speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
text: However, we need to be mindful of the stage of working with these startup incubators, as well as tech companies.

speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
text: Graduates that come out immediately from AUs may want to look for a longer-term job and certain type of career profile.

speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
text: For the broader groups of young graduates from our AUs, depending on the area of training and area of specialisation, we are prepared to consider partnerships, as long as there is also a clear career path for these young graduates.

speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
text: It is not as straightforward as applying this model universally across all the different sectors of the graduating cohorts, but we certainly explore and further curate some of these programmes, leveraging on the insights and the learning from the T-UP programme that we started a couple of years ago.

speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
text: On the second point, in terms of the leveraging on technology.

speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
text: This provides a better career trajectory and a more productive runway for them.

speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
text: On the use of data analytics and artificial intelligence, we are already leveraging on these technologies.

speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
text: Hopefully, that is the reassurance that I can give to the Member.
